VAL-SETUP-018.observed: curl POST /operator/reservations/setup/services created G5-Dinner (201: daysMask 127, firstSeatingMin 1080, lastSeatingMin 1290, endMin 1380, intervalMin 15, effectiveFrom 2026-11-02, effectiveTo 2026-11-05, onlineEnabled true, onlineCapPerInterval 20, concurrentCoversCap 60) and it renders on /acme/reservations/settings/services with its effective window; the UI edit changed last seating 21:30 -> 22:00 with 'Service updated.' feedback (PUT 200, version bumped); archiving through the UI delete ('Service deleted.') set archived_at on G5-Temp-Archive and G5-UI-Svc and removed both from the active list. Overnight service G5-Late Lounge (firstSeatingMin 1320, lastSeatingMin 1500, endMin 1560 - past midnight) -> 201, then archived via API. Invalid ordering rejected: firstSeatingMin>lastSeatingMin -> 400 invalid_seating_order; lastSeatingMin>endMin -> 400 invalid_seating_order; endMin-firstSeatingMin > 1440 -> 400 invalid_service_span. GET /locations/<acme>/services lists G5-Dinner with its effective range.
VAL-SETUP-018.notes: The UI create form was used for G5-UI-Svc (table row rendered immediately); G5-Dinner itself was created through the real API because the UI cannot set effective_from/effective_to. Network: POST /services 201, PUT 200, DELETE 200. No console errors.

VAL-SETUP-019.observed: Location-default bucket added via the UI: POST /turn-times {partyMin 11, partyMax 20, minutes 60, serviceId null} -> 201 tt_d610a54b-85a2-45ab-9711-c5865dc42beb, rendered in the UI bucket table (separate 'All services (default)' group). Per-service buckets for G5-Dinner (1-2 = 75 min, 3-4 = 90 min) added via the UI and then deleted via the UI ('Turn-time bucket added/deleted.' feedback). Rejections: minutes 10 -> 400 {"error":"invalid","fields":["minutes"],"issues":[{"path":"minutes","code":"too_small"}]}; minutes 600 -> 400 too_big; a per-service bucket overlapping 1-2 (2-3) -> 400 overlapping_turn_time_bucket naming the range ('Turn time party range [2, 3] overlaps existing bucket [1, 2]'); a default bucket overlapping 11-20 -> 400 overlapping_turn_time_bucket ('[11, 11] overlaps existing bucket [11, 20]'). The UI overlap message was reproduced by creating an overlapping per-service bucket from the form (400 surfaced in the row error text).
VAL-SETUP-019.notes: The location-default 11-20 bucket was intentionally kept (it closes the seeded party-size gap 11-20 and is what makes VAL-SETUP-024's zero-issues state reachable). Per-service buckets were deleted so no leftover rows exist. Console clean.

VAL-SETUP-020.observed: Create works from the UI: the pacing form on /acme/reservations/settings/services POSTed /pacing {serviceId G5-Dinner, bucketMin 15, fromMin 1080, toMin 1380, maxCovers 16, maxParties 5, channel all} -> 201 and the row rendered. Update via API: PUT /pacing/:id with rollingMin 60 / rollingMaxCovers 48 / channel online -> 200, sqlite + UI row reflected the new values. Delete via API: DELETE /pacing/:id -> 200 {"deleted":true}. Cap enforcement: with maxCovers 1 a POST /book/reservations for 2026-11-04 19:00 party 2 returned 409 pacing_exceeded ('Pacing limit exceeded for this interval; overbook override required'), and the same booking succeeded (201, then cancelled) after the rule was deleted. Delete from the UI FAILS: clicking the row's Delete sent DELETE /operator/reservations/setup/locations/v17plv08r5v357bie335lyq8/pacing/<id> -> 404 Endpoint Not Found (client setup-api.ts:1958-1966 builds a location-scoped path; tenant-api registers DELETE only at /pacing/:id and /pacing-rules/:id, operator-reservations-setup.ts:1482-1507).
VAL-SETUP-020.notes: Failure is scoped to the UI delete control (404). Everything else in the assertion works: UI create, API update/delete, and the pacing cap is enforced at booking create with 409 pacing_exceeded. Defect 1 of 3. Final state: rsv_pacing_rules back to the 3 seeded rows.

XOR validation: zero targets -> 400 {"error":"invalid_target","message":"Exactly one of areaId, tableId, or comboId is required"}; two targets -> the same 400; no row written. PUT /service-availability/:id -> 200 (mode/table updated) and DELETE /service-availability/:id -> 200 {"deleted":true}. Delete from the UI FAILS: the row's Delete button sent DELETE /operator/reservations/setup/locations/v17plv08r5v357bie335lyq8/service-availability/<id> -> 404 Endpoint Not Found (client setup-api.ts:2045-2053; tenant-api registers DELETE only at /service-availability/:id, operator-reservations-setup.ts:1644-1649).
VAL-SETUP-021.notes: Failure is scoped to the UI delete control (404, same defect class as VAL-SETUP-020). The four persisted rows (one per mode) were intentionally left in place as the assertion's evidence; they only reference my G5-Dinner service. Defect 2 of 3.

VAL-SETUP-022.observed: All four kinds were created for 2026-11-02..2026-11-05 and persisted in rsv_special_days: closed (2026-11-02), online_closed (2026-11-03), modified (2026-11-04, serviceId G5-Dinner + patch), replace (2026-11-05, replacement service G5-Gala Seating created with special_day_id linked to the special day). Create and delete were also driven from the special-days UI (create 201 + row rendered; UI delete -> 'Special day deleted.' / 'تم حذف اليوم الخاص.'). Inverted range -> 400 {"error":"invalid_date_range"}. PUT /special-days/:id -> 200 (name and publicNoteI18n {en,ar} updated, version 1->2). rsv_day_versions bumped for the affected dates on both create and delete: UI create on 2026-11-03 5->6, UI delete 6->7; final versions 11-02=4, 11-03=9, 11-04=3, 11-05=1. rsv_special_days now holds exactly the four rows on my dates.
VAL-SETUP-022.notes: Deviation reported for the 'validated patch' clause: the modified kind's patch is accepted unvalidated by the API (inverted {firstSeatingMin 1300, lastSeatingMin 1100} and out-of-range {firstSeatingMin -50, lastSeatingMin 99999} both returned 201 and were stored verbatim; both probe rows were deleted afterwards) and no server code path reads rsv_special_days.patch (written at rsv-setup-crud.ts:2831/2938; resolveServices callers pass only {id, businessDate, type, name} at rsv-setup-service.ts:1339-1345 and rsv-day-feed-service.ts:1604-1610, so a modified special day has no effect on resolved services). The UI does validate the patch client-side ('Select a service and valid hours for modified schedule.'). Core CRUD + day-version requirements of the assertion pass; the patch gap is a product defect recorded in friction.

friction.description: UI pacing delete returns HTTP 404 Endpoint Not Found (product defect). The client calls DELETE /operator/reservations/setup/locations/:locationId/pacing/:id (apps/app/app/utils/reservations/setup-api.ts:1958-1966) but tenant-api registers DELETE only at /pacing/:id and /pacing-rules/:id (apps/tenant-api/src/routes/operator-reservations-setup.ts:1482-1507).
friction.resolution: Recorded the browser-visible 404; verified update/delete through the real API so the rest of VAL-SETUP-020 could be established. No product code changed.

friction.description: UI service-availability delete returns HTTP 404 Endpoint Not Found (product defect). The client calls DELETE /operator/reservations/setup/locations/:locationId/service-availability/:id (apps/app/app/utils/reservations/setup-api.ts:2045-2053) while tenant-api registers DELETE only at /service-availability/:id (apps/tenant-api/src/routes/operator-reservations-setup.ts:1644-1649).
friction.resolution: Recorded the 404 with a screenshot; used the API delete path for cleanup. No product code changed.

friction.description: UI block create returns HTTP 500 (product defect). The block form on /acme/reservations/settings/special-days posts startMin/endMin; createBlockForLocation assigns localToInstant(...) - a LocalInstantResolution object (packages/reservations/src/time.ts:112-134) - to the numeric start_at/end_at columns (apps/tenant-api/src/services/rsv-setup-crud.ts:3049-3056), so the insert throws. Every UI attempt failed while the same block via startAt/endAt (API) succeeded.
friction.resolution: Captured the 500 screenshot and the server-side cause; exercised create/delete through the API for the rest of VAL-SETUP-023. No product code changed.

friction.description: UI blocks list renders times as '00:00 - 00:00' for a block whose start_at/end_at are correct (API-created area block for 2026-11-02 18:00-20:00 America/New_York rendered as 00:00 - 00:00).
friction.resolution: Captured a screenshot and the row text; deleted the probe block afterwards.

friction.description: A 'modified' special day stores its patch but nothing reads it: the API accepts unvalidated patches (inverted and out-of-range both 201) and neither resolveServices caller passes patch/customServices, so a modified special day has no effect on resolved services or the operator availability list.
friction.resolution: Reported as a deviation under VAL-SETUP-022 (CRUD + rsv_day_versions still verified); the two invalid probe rows were deleted.

friction.description: The operator availability slot list ignores pacing rules: with maxCovers=1 on G5-Dinner the slot list still returned all 17 slots; the cap is only enforced at booking create (409 pacing_exceeded).
friction.resolution: Reported as an observation; cap enforcement itself was verified through the booking endpoint.

friction.description: Seeded acme location-default turn-time buckets already contained a party-size gap 11..20, so the very first GET /validate was not issue-free; the round's zero-issues evidence needed an extra default bucket.
friction.resolution: Added the location-default 11-20 bucket (kept; it belongs to no other validator's dates) and captured the zero-issues state.

friction.description: agent-browser's shared daemon restarted between calls (session reset to about:blank, cookies lost), and 'eval --stdin' rejected scripts that redeclared top-level consts.
friction.resolution: Made every browser batch self-contained (fresh login + actions + capture in one call) and wrapped eval scripts in IIFEs.

friction.description: POST /book/reservations with channel 'in_person' was rejected; the operator booking API expects 'host'.
friction.resolution: Used channel 'host' for the pacing-cap probe booking.

summary: Tested 10 assertions (VAL-SETUP-018, 019, 020, 021, 022, 023, 024, 026, 029, 031): 7 pass, 3 fail. Services CRUD (UI create/edit/archive + 400s for invalid bounds and >1440 spans), turn-time buckets (default + per-service, 400s for minutes 10/600 and overlaps naming the range), special-day CRUD for all four kinds with rsv_day_versions bumps, the validate gap -> zero-issues transition, the timezone skew/rederive cycle (88-second skew, 28 reservations re-derived, invariant start_at = business_date + local_start_min, row back to America/New_York), KSA regional isolation (70 requests to :3009, 0 to :3007, Asia/Riyadh/SAR, no US writes) and Arabic RTL rendering with lingui:check exit 0 all verified. Three product defects fail assertions: UI pacing delete 404 (VAL-SETUP-020), UI service-availability delete 404 (VAL-SETUP-021), and UI block create 500 from localToInstant being inserted as start_at/end_at (VAL-SETUP-023); the same delete/create paths work through the API, and a fourth minor display defect (block times 00:00-00:00) plus a modified-special-day patch that is stored but never read are reported as frictions. All test rows were cleaned up except the intentional evidence rows (4 service-availability mode rows on G5-Dinner, the location-default 11-20 bucket, the four special days on 2026-11-02..11-05); git working tree is clean.
